05. 1.

The present contempt has been filed for the alleged disobedience of the order dated 05.03.2021 passed in W.P.(C) No.27334 of 2020, whereby a Division Bench of this Court had directed the completion of exercise of entitlement of the petitioner for grant of compensation amount to be assessed as per the new Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
2.

D.W. Department, Government of Odisha vide letter No.13034 dtd.13.07.2022 along Raju Bag vs Ashok Kumar Meena on 9 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/42477939/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
A copy of the said letter of Sanction dated 13.07.2022 is annexed here with in Annexure B/1.
4.
That, it is worth mentioning here that the Petitioner Raju Bag had filed the writ petition in a representative capacity only.
The case land stands recorded in the names of Shyama Bag, Niyam Bag, Kartika Bag, Sartika Bag all sons of Jala Bag in holding No.116 of Mouza- Khaprakhol.
It has been learnt from the report of the Tahasildar, Khaprakhol submitted vide letter No.246 dtd.25.2.2021 that all the RTs are dead now.
There are many legal heirs of the recorded tenants, all of whom are entitled to the compensation amount jointly and not only Raju Bag as claimed in this petition of contempt.

The land owners need to apply before the Tahasildar,
Khaprakhol for issuance of a mandatory legal heir certificate after which sale deeds need to be executed before the Sub- Registrar, Patnagarh.

A copy of the letter dtd.25.2.2021 of the Tahasildar,
Khaprakhol is annexed here with as Annexure-B/2.
6. That, the Panchayat Samiti, Khaprakhol is ready and willing to disburse the // 3 // compensation amount as soon as it is legally possible as stated above and comply the order of the Hon'ble High Court.
But the writ petitioner is unnecessarily delaying the matter.

Instead of producing the legal heir certificate and turning up with all legal heirs for execution and registration of the sale deed,
before the Sub- Registrar, Patnagarh, he is taking a long time to follow the procedures.
We are waiting for the land owners and the legal heirs to go ahead and comply the legal procedures and formalities for execution of the said registration of sale deed.
It is doubted that there might be some legal heir issues for which more caution need to be taken at this end.

The petitioner thus has not come to the court with clean hands and trying to take undue advantage of the order of the Hon'ble High Court passed in the writ petition in his agenda to take all the compensation amount alone,
excluding all the legal heirs."
3.
In view of the above, it is contended that there is no violation of the directions passed by this Court.
4. Upon perusal of the above, we are satisfied that the directions passed by this Court have been complied with to the extent possible.
5. In view of the above, the contempt proceedings are dropped and the CONTC is accordingly dismissed.
(Jaswant Singh) Judge (M.S. Sahoo) Judge AKK 9th February, 2023 Cuttack Raju Bag vs Ashok Kumar Meena on 9 February, 2023
